push.title: W 5-3 vs MLRookies | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #13)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, they don't make the rating any higher than that. Perfect Game #13 against MLRookies. Somebody ring a bell.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 13th Perfect Game for us. That's what showing up looks like.
+ 4 shots at MLRookies's goal. You made the keeper earn every dollar tonight.
+ 2 key passes. That pass had more vision than a lighthouse.
+ You set it up, BellyTb1 knocked it down. Repeat as needed.
+ Match rating 10.0, up from your usual 8.4. Little things like that are big things in disguise.

THE BAD
- 68% passing (23 of 34). Quick one: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Like riding a bike.
- 4 missed tackles cost 0.1. That's on the to-do list.
- Shots 4, from 7 in your previous match. Here's the fix: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on.

Rep it: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.

PhogsToffees, from me to you: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

I'm gonna go tell my plant about you. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 5-3 vs MLRookies | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #7)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a perfect 10.0 against MLRookies. Perfect Game #7. I don't have a speech for this. I'm just gonna stand here and clap.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 7th Perfect Game for us. That's growth you can count.
+ 88% passing on 25 attempts, up from your usual 74%. Tidier than my mama's guest bathroom.
+ 5 shots at MLRookies's goal. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ Man of the Match, your 20th for us. That's an award you earned, not one they handed you.

THE BAD
- 2 of 5 shots on target. Here's how: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. Trust the work.
- 3 tackles won pulled 0.2 off. We'll get it back.
- Worst passes attempted of your 4 matches this session (25). Little adjustment: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.

Training note: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso
